# Three.js r180

Pinned, unmodified modules from `three@0.180.0`, downloaded from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/`.

The core modules, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, and
RoomEnvironment are served locally so the Omatiller viewer has no runtime CDN
dependency. Import mapping is scoped to the Omatiller page. See LICENSE.
